wins: Maintained steady reward accumulation (total 90) by successfully executing early-stage enumeration steps despite not completing final objective.
Used mentor guidance effectively, resolving ambiguous instructions through 10 mentor calls without derailing the action plan.
fails: Failed to finish the exploitation phase; critical service remained unexploited, resulting in 0% success rate.
Could not validate the final foothold persistence checks, indicating missing post-exploitation verification.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance posture produced consistent intermediate rewards, but execution stalled before achieving the final success criteria.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Final exploitation stage never reached due to inability to chain identified vulnerabilities into a working payload delivery.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to identify supported ciphers and login banners for later brute-force attempts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns a 200 response with HTML structure indicating login page
skill_cards.then_action: Launch a headless browser validation to map hidden form fields before issuing credential-based tests

skill_cards.if_condition: When reconnaissance identifies enumeration gaps after initial scans
skill_cards.then_action: Trigger aggressive service discovery (nmap -sC -sV) focusing on filtered ports to ensure no services were missed

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SSH reconnaissance provided consistent actionable data.
Aggressive service discovery repeatedly uncovered hidden ports before exploitation attempts.
